notes.title: Mod Update - 0.8.0
notes.notes:
Hello, this is Team Offbeat.

We’re excited to announce the release of VR Mode!

[h1]VR Mode[/h1]
You can now experience SOUNDSCAPE in VR. This allows for a more immersive experience, with several systems optimized for VR gameplay.
When you wear the VR headset and launch the app, it will automatically start in VR mode.

[h2]Changes in the System[/h2]
[list]
[*] Instead of simply right-clicking, using the white cane now involves physically swinging it in space.
[*] The braille system has been simplified.
[/list]


[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where tutorial text was displayed incorrectly.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix - 0.6.3
notes.notes:
We have released an updated version with the following fixes:

[list]
[*] Footsteps no longer play on the braille screen.

Thank you for your support!
